command:
set -eu
echo PROCESS_CHECK_BEGIN
cat /proc/uptime
for pid in 29567 4886; do
if test -d /proc/$pid; then
echo "PID $pid"
cat /proc/$pid/status | awk '/^Name:|^State:|^Pid:|^PPid:|^Uid:|^Threads:/ {print}'
readlink /proc/$pid/exe
cat /proc/$pid/stat
else echo "ABSENT $pid"; fi
done
echo PROCESS_CHECK_END
reason: identify existing SIG11 log task, no crash inference
